main.description: Acts on someone in a voice channel. An absent field leaves the current value unchanged.

channel.description: The voice channel the subject is in.

muted.description: Whether the subject's microphone is muted. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

deafened.description: Whether the subject cannot hear others. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

disconnect.description: Whether to disconnect the subject from the channel.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the voice.moderate permission.

errors.name: ChannelNotFound
errors.description: No channel matches the given space reference.

errors.name: NotInVoice
errors.description: The subject is not currently connected to the channel.

errors.name: VoiceUnavailable
errors.description: This AppView has no voice SFU running.
